description:
Prior Approval (Class G) for change of use of first, second and loft floors of the property from commercial use (Class E (a)) to a self-contained
residential unit (Class C3).
decision_conditions:
The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

<p>Prior to first occupation of the development hereby approved, details of refuse and recycling storage and management arrangements shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall not be occupied until the approved facilities are provided and shall thereafter be retained and maintained.</p><p><br></p><p>Reason: To ensure adequate and appropriate waste storage and collection arrangements are provided in accordance with Part G, Class G of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015.</p>

<p>Prior to first occupation of the development hereby approved, a noise impact assessment shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The assessment shall consider the impact of noise from any commercial premises on the intended occupiers of the development and shall identify any mitigation measures necessary to ensure acceptable internal noise levels. Any mitigation measures identified shall be implemented prior to first occupation and thereafter retained.</p><p>Reason: To safeguard the amenity of future occupiers in accordance with Part G, Class G of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015.</p>
